name: Jackal
summary: Miles Warren is the geneticist who becomes the Jackal and engineers the clones at the center of the Clone Saga, including Ben Reilly. He is a Spider-Man villain whose damage is scientific rather than a simple robbery.
relation: Spider-Man villain. Architect of the clone stories.
firstAppearance: Miles Warren appears earlier as a professor. The Jackal identity debuts in The Amazing Spider-Man #129 (1974).
creators: The Jackal identity is credited to Gerry Conway and Ross Andru.
powers: Genetic cloning and, in the costume, enhanced agility.
origin: An ESU professor whose obsession curdles into the Jackal persona.
